title: Valid Palindrome
statement:
Given a string s, determine if it is a valid palindrome, considering only alphanumeric characters and ignoring cases.

A palindrome is a word, phrase, number, or other sequence of characters that reads the same forward and backward (ignoring spaces, punctuation, and capitalization).
constraints: s consists of printable ASCII characters

input.s: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama

visibleExamples.explanation: After removing non-alphanumeric characters and converting to lowercase: 'amanaplanacanalpanama' is a palindrome.
After processing: 'raceacar' is not a palindrome.
An empty string (after removing spaces) is considered a valid palindrome.
